cases.name: where
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP SEQUENCE qual_ticks; CREATE TEMP TABLE qual_input(n integer PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO qual_input VALUES(1),(2),(3); CREATE TEMP TABLE qual_output(n integer,b boolean);
cases.operation: INSERT INTO qual_output(n) SELECT n FROM qual_input WHERE nextval('qual_ticks') > 0 AND NULL::boolean
cases.observe: SELECT json_build_object('calls',(SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END FROM qual_ticks),'input',(SELECT json_agg(n ORDER BY n) FROM qual_input),'output',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_array(n,b) ORDER BY n) FROM qual_output))
